apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.41.0 - BEACON SECRETARY ON THE PHONE (and Website Update 101, rules 54)
  - The office officers (Officer: Secretary, Officer: Admin, and the lead pastor) have Beacon Secretary on the phone:
    https://<your project>.web.app/secretary/ (Chrome → ⋮ → Install app; iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen),
    signed in with their member ID and PIN. Members: find, see, change the details, add a new member, archive, bring back.
    Who came: a date, who checked in, check someone in or take a check-in away. Reports: members by category, the last
    services, the months, birthdays by month.
  - This program stays the master copy: each change from the phone is done here at the next sync (as if done here) and the
    phone shows "done" with the result (a new member's ID). The sync line says how many changes came from the phone.
  - This program's copy of the portal page and the rules: Website Update 101 (rules version 54), with website/secretary/.

apps.name: Beacon Admin
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.29.0: THE PASTOR CHOOSES THE ROLES - Who is in Beacon Admin on the phone, who is told of replies to assignments, and the Music Leader(s) are chosen by the pastor in ONE place (Beacon Pastor on the phone → Roles). This program takes his lists at every sync (every 2 minutes while signed in) and shows them as "set by the pastor": they cannot be changed here. A list the pastor has not saved yet stays as it is here. Needs Website Update 100 (rules 53).
